{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (above 0.67), model forecasts undershoot true prices by 1-3% due to lagging on rapid sentiment shifts",
    "Negative sentiment (below 0) causes model to overforecast by 2-4% as it can't fully capture rapid price corrections",
    "When price is at 18-day low, model lacks bottoming confidence and forecasts 1-2% too high",
    "Mean reversion bias: model forecasts too close to recent levels when true prices continue trending away from mean",
    "High volatility periods (price range > 8 over 18 days) amplify all forecast errors by 30-50%",
    "Sentiment turning points correlate with 2-3 day forecast lag where the curve shape doesn't match true price acceleration",
    "When sentiment alternates quickly (every 3-4 days), model smooths these changes resulting in 0.5-1.0% daily forecast error"
] }
